Maya (AE): Quick heads-up: VectorLabs RFI inbound. Must-haves: private control plane, customer HSM import, no request-body telemetry, and a 2-week POC focused on embeddings throughput. Need capability matrix + rough commercial by EOD.
Ravi (SE): Understood. Can you confirm expected sustained qps and avg tokens? Also whether they need embeddings+chat concurrently.
Maya (AE): They said 25 qps embed sustained, 150 burst, avg 300 tokens. Chat minimal. They insist on signed key-import attestation for HSM.
Tess (SalesEng): Timeline: week0 prep (network + legal), week1 deploy + perf, week2 integration & acceptance. I'll draft capability matrix: features vs compliance checkboxes.
Omar (Security): We support KMIP import in Private; signed import requires key ceremony. Telemetry: we can disable request bodies and PII, but anonymized latency/error metrics remain for SLOs. I'll prepare a 1-page security ask.
InfraBot: Peering checklist: need customer CIDR, allowed ports, and S3 endpoint config for log storage. Ticket INF-4492 created.
Ravi (SE): Perf plan: recommend 2xA10x GPUs with batching + prefix cache for 300-token embeds. I'll create a small harness and load script.
LegalBot: KMS addendum draft and SOC2 link uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/kms-addendum-draft.pdf https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/soc2-2025.pdf. Ticket LEG-8301.
Maya (AE): Please drop artifacts in Drive: https://drive.redwood/team-sales/pocs/vectorlabs. We'll aim to send the capability matrix and estimate within 24 hours after tomorrow's sync.
Tess (SalesEng): Scheduling 30m sync with VectorLabs tomorrow 9am PT to confirm HSM flow and acceptance tests.
Maya (AE): Thanks all, prioritize security + infra confirmations. :thumbsup:
